question: What is Iyer's record against Hazlewood?
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "balls_faced", SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "dismissals" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."player_name" LIKE '%Iyer' AND T3."player_name" LIKE '%Hazlewood' GROUP BY T2."player_name"
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.bowler_id = 'Hazlewood' AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS Dismissals
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    p.player_name = 'Iyer'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name;

question: Shepherd కి ఓవర్ 19-20 లో బాటింగ్ స్టాటస్ ఏమిటి(పరుగులు, బంతులు, అవుట్, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ఫోర్లు, సిక్సులు)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS "Runs",
  COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Balls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_out_id = T2.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dismissals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fours",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sixes",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'R Shepherd%' AND T1.over_number >= 18 AND NOT (
    T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL
  );
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
    SUM(ball_number) AS Balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Dismissals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Fours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sixes,
    ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) / SUM(ball_number) * 100, 2) AS Strike_Rate
FROM Deliveries
WHERE 
    striker_id = 'Shepherd'
    AND over_number BETWEEN 19 AND 20
    AND wides = 0
    AND noballs = 0;

question: List all batsmen with at least 1000 runs against any team in ipl.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  "striker",
  CASE
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' THEN 'Hyderabad'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Capitals' THEN 'Delhi'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Punjab Kings' THEN 'Punjab'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Pune Warriors'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiants' THEN 'Pune'
    ELSE "bowling_team"
  END AS Opponent,
  SUM("runs_scored") AS TotalRuns
FROM "Deliveries"
GROUP BY
  "striker",
  Opponent
HAVING
  SUM("runs_scored") >= 1000
ORDER BY
  TotalRuns DESC;

        JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
        WHERE m.series_name = 'IPL'
    )
)

question: how many players have taken 20+ wickets for all punjab franchises in an ipl edition, list them with number of wickets taken by them
gold_sql: SELECT T3.player_name, T2.season, COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS wickets_taken FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1.bowler_id = T3.player_id WHERE (CASE WHEN T1.bowling_team IN ('Kings XI Punjab','Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' ELSE T1.bowling_team END)='Punjab Kings' AND T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field','retired out') GROUP BY T2.season, T3.player_name HAVING wickets_taken>=20 ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC;

    m.season AS Season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wickets_Taken

question: How many matches have been won by mumbai in ahmedabad?List both the teams with their scores.
gold_sql:
WITH TeamScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)

  T1."batting_team" AS "Team1",
  T1.total_runs AS "Team1_Score",
  T2."batting_team" AS "Team2",

FROM "Matches" AS M
JOIN TeamScores AS T1
  ON M."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND M."team1" = T1."batting_team"
JOIN TeamScores AS T2
  ON M."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND M."team2" = T2."batting_team"

FROM Matches
JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
WHERE venue = 'Ahmedabad'
GROUP BY team1, team2;

question: एक सीज़न में पंजाब के किसी बल्लेबाज़ द्वारा लगाए गए सबसे ज़्यादा छक्कों की सूची दें।
gold_sql:
SELECT

  T2."season",

FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3

LIMIT 5;

FROM

    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN

JOIN

question: IPL లో ఒక టీం పై కనీసం 1000 పరుగులు సాధించిన బ్యాట్స్‌మెన్‌లందరి పేరులు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  "striker",
  CASE
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' THEN 'Hyderabad'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Capitals' THEN 'Delhi'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Punjab Kings' THEN 'Punjab'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Pune Warriors'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiants' THEN 'Pune'
    ELSE "bowling_team"
  END AS Opponent,
  SUM("runs_scored") AS TotalRuns
FROM "Deliveries"
GROUP BY
  "striker",
  Opponent
HAVING
  SUM("runs_scored") >= 1000
ORDER BY
  TotalRuns DESC;

gold_answer: ["('Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad', '2025-06-01')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2025-04-07')", "('Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow', '2024-04-30')", "('Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur', '2024-04-22')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2024-04-14')"]

SELECT 
    v.venue AS Venue,
    m.start_date AS Match Date
FROM Matches AS m
LEFT JOIN Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id

AND d.bowler_id = 'Bumrah'

question: Out of bowlers who have played atleat 50 matches, list the bowlers who have the most instances of taking atleast one wicket in a match.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.match_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, bowler_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) >= 50) GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.match_id) DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS Wickets Taken
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    p.player_id = d.bowler_id
    AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) > 50
ORDER BY 
    Wickets Taken DESC;

gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.match_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, bowler_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) >= 50) GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.match_id) DESC LIMIT 5

    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wickets Taken
FROM 
    Players p

question: List all instances of a knockout match where a team scored 200+ but none of the players scored a half century.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    M.start_date AS Match_Date,
    M.venue AS Venue,
    D.batting_team AS Batting_Team,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs
FROM 
    Matches AS M
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
    M.match_type_number = 1
    AND M.result_type = 'normal'
    AND SUM(D.runs_scored) >= 200
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Deliveries AS D2
        WHERE D2.match_id = M.match_id
        AND D2.runs_scored >= 50
    )
GROUP BY 
    M.start_date, M.venue, D.batting_team
ORDER BY 
    M.start_date;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC

    M.start_date AS Match_Date,
    M.venue AS Venue,
    D.batting_team AS Batting_Team,

    Matches AS M

question: IPL 2025 के डेथ ओवर्स में सबसे ज़्यादा रन किसने बनाए? इस फेज़ में उनके द्वारा बनाए गए रन और खेली गईं गेंदों की संख्या बताएं।
gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "balls_played" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" >= 16 GROUP BY T3."player_name" ORDER BY "total_runs" DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Played
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 2
    AND d.over_number BETWEEN 19 AND 20
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Total Runs DESC;

question: ਉਹਨਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 200+ ਸਕੋਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਹੋਣ ਪਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ 50+ ਨਾ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੋਵੇ।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    M.start_date AS Match_Date,
    M.venue AS Venue,
    D.batting_team AS Batting_Team,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs
FROM 
    Matches AS M
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
    M.result_type = 'match'
    AND SUM(D.runs_scored) > 200
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM PlayerInMatch AS PIM
        WHERE PIM.match_id = M.match_id
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Deliveries AS D2
            WHERE D2.match_id = PIM.match_id
            AND D2.striker_id = PIM.player_id
            AND SUM(D2.runs_scored) >= 50
        )
    )
GROUP BY 
    M.start_date, M.venue, D.batting_team
ORDER BY 
    M.start_date;

question: MI का IPL प्लेऑफ़ में पहले बल्लेबाज़ी और पहले फ़ील्डिंग करने का रिकॉर्ड दिखाओ।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (T1.toss_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'bat') OR (T1.toss_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'field')
    THEN 'Batting First'
    ELSE 'Fielding First'
  END AS "MI_Action",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "Matches_Played",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Wins",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Losses"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
WHERE
  (T1.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' OR T1.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians') AND T1.stage <> 'Group'
GROUP BY
  "MI_Action";

    CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'बल्लेबाजी' ELSE 'फील्डिंग' END AS MI_Action,

    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'MI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner <> 'MI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Losses
FROM Matches
WHERE team1 = 'MI' OR team2 = 'MI'
GROUP BY MI_Action;

question: IPL 2025 లో 7 నుండి 15 ఓవర్ల మద్య Bumrah బౌలింగ్ గణాంకాలు చూబిచ్చంది.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / 6.0 AS "Overs Bowled",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1."delivery_id"), 0) AS "Economy Rate",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Average",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"

question: Show players with the most 25-plus scores in Men’s T20 competitions.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  p."player_name",
  COUNT(ps."striker_id") AS "num_25_plus_scores"
FROM PlayerScores AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p
  ON ps."striker_id" = p."player_id"
WHERE
  ps."total_runs" >= 25
GROUP BY
  p."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_25_plus_scores" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS Number of 25+ Scores
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored >= 25
    AND m.gender = 'Male'
    AND m.team_type = 'T20'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Number of 25+ Scores DESC;

question: Show MI’s highest opening partnerships in IPL playoffs.
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning
), Opening_Batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id,
    non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    over_number = 0 AND ball_number = 1
)
SELECT
  p1.player_name AS "Batsman 1",
  p2.player_name AS "Batsman 2",
  op.partnership_runs AS "Partnership Runs",
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS "Opponent",
  m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Opening_Partnerships AS op
INNER JOIN Opening_Batsmen AS ob
  ON op.match_id = ob.match_id AND op.inning = ob.inning
INNER JOIN Matches AS m
  ON op.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p1
  ON ob.striker_id = p1.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p2
  ON ob.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: List matches where MI scored 80 or more runs for the first wicket in IPL playoffs.
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."inning" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."stage" != 'Group' AND T1."batting_team" = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS first_wicket_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Deliveries
  WHERE
    wicket_group = 0
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."match_date",
  T1."venue",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."team1" = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN T1."team2"
    ELSE T1."team1"
  END AS opponent,
  T2.first_wicket_runs
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN First_Wicket_Partnerships AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T2.first_wicket_runs >= 80
ORDER BY
  T2.first_wicket_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL प्लेऑफ़ में MI की सबसे बड़ी ओपनिंग साझेदारियाँ दिखाओ।
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning
), Opening_Batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id,
    non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    over_number = 0 AND ball_number = 1
)
SELECT
  p1.player_name AS "Batsman 1",
  p2.player_name AS "Batsman 2",
  op.partnership_runs AS "Partnership Runs",
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS "Opponent",
  m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Opening_Partnerships AS op
INNER JOIN Opening_Batsmen AS ob
  ON op.match_id = ob.match_id AND op.inning = ob.inning
INNER JOIN Matches AS m
  ON op.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p1
  ON ob.striker_id = p1.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p2
  ON ob.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL ਪਲੇਅ-ਔਫ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ ਜਿੱਥੇ MI ਨੇ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਿਕਟ ਲਈ 80 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ।
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."inning" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."stage" != 'Group' AND T1."batting_team" = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS first_wicket_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Deliveries
  WHERE
    wicket_group = 0
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."match_date",
  T1."venue",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."team1" = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN T1."team2"
    ELSE T1."team1"
  END AS opponent,
  T2.first_wicket_runs
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN First_Wicket_Partnerships AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T2.first_wicket_runs >= 80
ORDER BY
  T2.first_wicket_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

gold_sql:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."batting_team",
    T1."striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."batting_team" ORDER BY T1.first_ball_faced) AS batting_position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_ball_faced
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id"
  ) AS T1
), MatchTop3Lineup AS (
  SELECT
    M."season",
    B."batting_team",
    GROUP_CONCAT(B."striker_id" ORDER BY B.batting_position) AS top_3_batters
  FROM BattingOrder AS B
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON B.match_id = M.match_id

question: IPL 2025 లో GT యొక్క బ్యాటింగ్ ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ని MI యొక్క బౌలింగ్ ఆవెరేజ్, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ మరియు ఎకానమీ రేట్ తో పోల్చండి.
gold_sql: WITH GT_Batting AS (SELECT CAST(SUM("runs_scored") AS REAL) AS gt_total_runs, COUNT("player_out_id") AS gt_dismissals, COUNT("delivery_id") AS gt_balls_faced FROM "Deliveries" INNER JOIN "Matches" ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id" WHERE "Matches"."season" = '2025' AND "Deliveries"."batting_team" = 'Gujarat Titans'), MI_Bowling AS (SELECT CAST(SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS REAL) AS mi_runs_conceded, COUNT(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS mi_wickets_taken, COUNT("delivery_id") AS mi_balls_bowled FROM "Deliveries" INNER JOIN "Matches" ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id" WHERE "Matches"."season" = '2025' AND "Deliveries"."bowling_team" = 'Mumbai Indians') SELECT gt_total_runs / gt_dismissals AS "GT Batting Average", gt_total_runs * 100 / gt_balls_faced AS "GT Batting Strike Rate", mi_runs_conceded / mi_wickets_taken AS "MI Bowling Average", CAST(mi_balls_bowled AS REAL) / mi_wickets_taken AS "MI Bowling Strike Rate", mi_runs_conceded * 6 / mi_balls_bowled AS "MI Bowling Economy" FROM GT_Batting, MI_Bowling
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(runs_scored / (CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS GT_Batting_Average,
    AVG(runs_scored / (CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS GT_Batting_Strike_Rate,
    AVG(runs_scored / deliveries.deliveries) AS MI_Bowling_Average,
    AVG((runs_scored / deliveries.deliveries) * 100) AS MI_Bowling_Strike_Rate,
    AVG(runs_scored / deliveries.deliveries) AS MI_Bowling_Economy
FROM 
    Deliveries
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch ON Deliveries.match_id = PlayerInMatch.match_id
JOIN 
    Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE 
    Matches.season = 'IPL 2025' AND 
    PlayerInMatch.team_name = 'GT' AND 
    Deliveries.bowling_team = 'MI'
GROUP BY 
    Matches.season;

SELECT 
  AVG(runs_scored / (COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 END))) AS GT_Batting_Average,

question: *IPL 2025 में पावरप्ले ओवर्स में मेडन ओवर डालने वाले सभी गेंदबाज़ों को दिखाएँ।**
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3."player_name" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."bowler_id" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") = 0;
gold_answer: ["('JC Archer',)", "('VG Arora',)", "('Mukesh Kumar',)", "('MM Ali',)", "('DL Chahar',)", "('KA Jamieson',)"]

    p.player_name AS PlayerName

    Players p

WHERE 
    m.season = 'IPL 2025'
    AND d.over_number <= 6
    AND d.inning = 1

question: list the 5 lowest team totals in ipl playoffs.List the scores, the team and the year.

gold_sql: WITH TeamStats AS (SELECT T1."bowling_team", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."extra_runs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dot_percentage FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' GROUP BY T1."bowling_team"), RankedStats AS (SELECT "bowling_team", "economy", "dot_percentage", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "economy" ASC) AS economy_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "dot_percentage" DESC) AS dot_rank FROM TeamStats) SELECT "bowling_team", "economy", "dot_percentage" FROM RankedStats ORDER BY (economy_rank + dot_rank) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH TeamEconomy AS (
    SELECT
        bowling_team AS BowlingTeam,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,

        COUNT(DISTINCT delivery_id) AS deliveries
    FROM Deliveries

    GROUP BY bowling_team
),
TeamDotBallPercentage AS (

question: IPL में PBKS के खिलाफ़ विराट कोहली का कुल बल्लेबाज़ी रिकॉर्ड बताइए — मैच, रन, औसत, स्ट्राइक रेट, शतक और अर्धशतक।
gold_sql:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"
FROM KohliMatchRuns AS T1, KohliDismissals AS T2;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਸਫਲ ਰਨ-ਚੇਜ਼ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਨੰਬਰ 6 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS batting_position
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
), PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "batting_team"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T4."venue",
  T4."match_date"
FROM BattingOrder AS T1
INNER JOIN PlayerScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T1."match_id" = T4."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.inning = 2 AND T1.batting_position >= 6 AND T2.batting_team = T4.match_winner
ORDER BY
  T2.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: what is the highest partnership for RCB for 5th wicket or lower in a run-chase.Give the batsman involved with the partnership.
gold_sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Find the top 5 players with the highest strike rates who scored atleast 400 runs in an ipl season.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: List the teams that failed to have a 50 run opening stand in a season.List the teams,year and their highest opening stand for that season
gold_sql:
WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";
generated_sql:

    team1 AS Team,
    strftime('%Y', start_date) AS Year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 AND over_number = 1 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS Highest Opening Stand

JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
GROUP BY team1, strftime('%Y', start_date)
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 AND over_number = 1 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) < 50;

    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";

GROUP BY team1, strftime('%Y', start_date)
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 AND ball_number = 6 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) < 50

question: List all instances of 200+ targets getting chased down in jaipur.

  T1."season",
  T1."venue",
  T2.inning1_score + 1 AS target,
  T1."match_winner" AS chasing_team
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning1_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning2_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
) AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."city" = 'Jaipur' AND T2.inning1_score >= 199 AND T3.inning2_score > T2.inning1_score;

question: IPL 2025 के आखिरी 5 ओवरों में सबसे ज़्यादा स्ट्राइक रेट वाले टॉप 5 बल्लेबाज़ कौन हैं? (कम से कम 25 गेंदें खेली हों)। उनकी सूची रन, खेली गई गेंदों और स्ट्राइक रेट के साथ दें।

question: List the top 5 players who have missed the most matches between 2 appearances for a franchise.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2
    WHERE
      (
        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"
      )
      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"
  ) AS "missed_matches"
FROM PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"

      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'

WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)

  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2

        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"

      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"

INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 4 Highest partnership average in ipl with minimum 1000 runs.
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: IPL में सबसे ज़्यादा साझेदारी औसत वाली शीर्ष 4 जोड़ियाँ (न्यूनतम 1000 रन)।
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: उन टॉप 5 खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए, जिनके किन्हीं दो मैचों में खेलने के बीच उनकी फ्रेंचाइज़ी ने सबसे ज़्यादा मैच खेले।
gold_sql:
WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('KV Sharma', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 209)", "('Mandeep Singh', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 190)", "('MA Agarwal', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 177)", "('MR Marsh', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 149)", "('S Dhawan', 'Delhi Capitals', 147)"]

    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS PlayerName,
        pm.team_name AS FranchiseName,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d1.match_id = d2.match_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS MatchesMissed
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d1 ON pm.match_id = d1.match_id AND pm.team_name = d1.bowling_team
    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON pm.match_id = d2.match_id AND pm.team_name = d2.bowling_team
    GROUP BY p.player_name, pm.team_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d1.match_id) >= 2
),
RankedFranchises AS (
    SELECT 
        PlayerName,
        FranchiseName,
        MatchesMissed,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PlayerName ORDER BY MatchesMissed ASC) AS Rank
    FROM PlayerFranchises
)
SELECT 
    PlayerName,
    FranchiseName,
    MatchesMissed
FROM RankedFranchises
WHERE Rank <= 5
ORDER BY PlayerName, MatchesMissed ASC;

question: లఖనఊ లో ఒక మ్యాచ్లో 2 అన్నిటికన్నా త్వరగా టీం 50 లు ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: WITH TeamScores AS (SELECT T1.match_id, T1.inning, T1.batting_team, SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.match_id, T1.inning ORDER BY T1.over_number, T1.ball_number) AS cumulative_runs, (T1.over_number * 6 + T1.ball_number) AS balls FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id WHERE T2.city = 'Lucknow') SELECT batting_team, MIN(balls) AS balls_to_50 FROM TeamScores WHERE cumulative_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, inning ORDER BY balls_to_50 ASC LIMIT 2
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    batting_team AS Batting_Team,
    (
        SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 6
        FROM Deliveries
        WHERE match_id = Matches.match_id
        AND batting_team = batting_team
        AND inning = 1
        AND wides = 0
        AND noballs = 0
    ) AS Balls_to_50_Runs
FROM Matches
JOIN PlayerInMatch ON Matches.match_id = PlayerInMatch.match_id
JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
GROUP BY batting_team
ORDER BY Balls_to_50_Runs ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: highest partnership for lsg for 2nd wicket or lower.
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipData AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants'
), PartnershipPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group,
    MIN("striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id") AS p2_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM PartnershipData
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T3."player_name",
  T1.partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipPairs AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1.p1_id = T2."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1.p2_id = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.wicket_group >= 1
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Partner_1,
    p2.player_name AS Partner_2,
    SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS Partnership_Runs
FROM 
    Deliveries AS d1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id AND p1.team_name = 'LSG'
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS p2 ON d1.non_striker_id = p2.player_id AND p2.team_name = 'LSG'
WHERE 
    d1.inning = 1
    AND d1.wicket_type IS NULL
    AND d1.ball_number = (SELECT MIN(ball_number) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = d1.match_id AND inning = 1 AND striker_id = d1.striker_id AND non_striker_id = d1.non_striker_id)
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_name, p2.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Partnership_Runs DESC;

question: the 3 batsmen to Reach 50 in 25 or fewer balls most times in a season
gold_sql:
WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty
  WHERE
    "balls_taken" <= 25
), SeasonCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "num_fast_fifties"
  FROM FastFifties
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "season"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."season",
  T1."num_fast_fifties"
FROM SeasonCounts AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."num_fast_fifties" DESC
LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    m.season AS Season,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Number of Fast Fifties
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE d.runs_scored >= 50
  AND d.ball_number <= 25
  AND d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
  AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY p.player_name, m.season DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 1000 ਰਨ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੀਆਂ 4 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਔਸਤਾਂ।
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (

      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty
  WHERE
    "balls_taken" <= 25
), SeasonCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "num_fast_fifties"
  FROM FastFifties
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "season"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."season",
  T1."num_fast_fifties"
FROM SeasonCounts AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."num_fast_fifties" DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: किसी एक विपक्षी टीम के खिलाफ किसी खिलाड़ी का सर्वोच्च बल्लेबाजी औसत, जिसने उस टीम के खिलाफ कम से कम 500 रन बनाए हों। रन, स्ट्राइक रेट और औसत की सूची दें।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1

    p.player_name AS Player_Name,
    d.bowling_team AS Opponent,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 6)), 2) AS Strike_Rate,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS Average
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.bowling_team IS NOT NULL
    AND d.runs_scored > 0
    AND SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 500
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, d.bowling_team
ORDER BY 
    Total_Runs DESC;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1

WITH PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        d.batting_team AS Opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS TotalRuns
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, d.batting_team
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 500
),
PlayerStrikeRate AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        d.batting_team AS Opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS TotalRuns,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / (SUM(d.ball_number) / 6) AS StrikeRate
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, d.batting_team
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 500
),
PlayerAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        d.batting_team AS Opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS TotalRuns,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Average
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, d.batting_team
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 500
)

    pr.PlayerName,
    pr.Opponent,
    pr.TotalRuns,
    psr.StrikeRate,
    pa.Average

JOIN PlayerAverage pa ON pr.PlayerName = pa.PlayerName AND pr.Opponent = pa.Opponent;

question: Top 4 Highest SR for a batter in an IPL season (min. 100 balls faced)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    m.season AS Season,
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) / (SUM(d.ball_number) / 6)) * 100, 2) AS Strike Rate
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'IPL'
    AND d.ball_number > 0
    AND SUM(d.ball_number) / 6 >= 100
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY 
    Strike Rate DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: ఒక IPL సీజన్లో ఒక బ్యాట్స్మ్యాన్ యొక్క టాప్ 4 అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి (కనీసం 100 బంతులను ఎదురుకున్నాడు)?
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS PlayerName,
    m.season AS Season,
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.ball_number) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))) * 100, 2) AS StrikeRate
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'IPL 2023'
    AND d.inning = 1
    AND d.ball_number > 100
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY 
    StrikeRate DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: list every team's runrate and boundary percentage in powerplay in ipl 2025..
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "run_rate",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "boundary_percentage"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5
GROUP BY
  T1."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  run_rate DESC;

    BattingTeam AS Batting_Team,
    CAST(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS REAL) / (SUM(over_number * 6 + ball_number / 6) ) AS Run_Rate,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT delivery_id) AS Boundary_Percentage
FROM Deliveries
JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE 
    Matches.season = '2025' AND 
    Matches.team_type = 'IPL' AND

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" BETWEEN 6 AND 14 GROUP BY T2."player_name" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 75 ORDER BY "strike_rate" DESC LIMIT 5

question: list the number of times each team has chased a total of 200 or more.
gold_sql:
WITH Inning1Scores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "inning1_total"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
), ChasingTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1.match_winner
  END AS "team_name",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "successful_chases"
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN Inning1Scores AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
JOIN ChasingTeams AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T1.match_winner = T3.batting_team AND T2.inning1_total >= 199

  "team_name"

  "successful_chases" DESC;

ORDER BY

question: IPL में 20 गेंदों से कम में सबसे ज़्यादा बार 50 रन बनाने वाले टॉप 4 खिलाड़ी।
gold_sql:
WITH CumulativeStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT ("extra_runs" > 0 AND "runs_scored" = 0 AND "wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), InningsFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50"
  FROM CumulativeStats
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  COUNT(T1."striker_id") AS "fast_fifties_count"
FROM InningsFifty AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."balls_to_reach_50" < 20
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "fast_fifties_count" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Fast Fifties Count
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored >= 50
    AND d.over_number <= 2
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Fast Fifties Count DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: LSG యొక్క 100+ పరుగులు ఉన్న అన్నీ ఓపెనింగ్ భాగస్వామ్యాలు ఏమిటి? మొత్తం పరుగులు మరియు ఉన్న బ్యాట్స్మెన్ల పేరులు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
INNER JOIN OpeningBatsmen AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."non_striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.batting_team = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1.partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC;

WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (

question: the 5 most 100+ partnerships for a pair
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT

    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,

question: Most opening stands of more than 50 by a pair in an IPL season

WITH FirstWicket AS (

), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"

)

  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'
          ) OR (
            T3."team1" = 'Gujarat Titans' AND (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
          )
        )
      GROUP BY
        T1."match_id"
      HAVING
        SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 100
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_faced",
  MAX("cumulative_runs_scored") AS "runs_scored"
FROM PlayerInnings
WHERE
  "cumulative_balls_faced" > 0
GROUP BY
  ("cumulative_balls_faced" - 1) / 20
ORDER BY
  "balls_faced";

question: एक IPL सीज़न में किसी जोड़ी द्वारा सबसे ज़्यादा 50+ रन की ओपनिंग पार्टनरशिप।
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"
INNER JOIN OpeningPairs AS T7
  ON T3."match_id" = T7."match_id"
  AND T3."inning" = T7."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T7.player1_id = T5."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6
  ON T7.player2_id = T6."player_id"
WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50
GROUP BY
  T4."season",
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name"
ORDER BY
  num_50_plus_stands DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ఒక IPL సీజన్లో ఏ జంట అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ 50+ పరుగుల ఓపెనింగ్ భాగస్వామ్యాలు చేశారు?
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"
INNER JOIN OpeningPairs AS T7
  ON T3."match_id" = T7."match_id"
  AND T3."inning" = T7."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T7.player1_id = T5."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6
  ON T7.player2_id = T6."player_id"
WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50
GROUP BY
  T4."season",
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name"
ORDER BY
  num_50_plus_stands DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Player_1_Name,
    p2.player_name AS Player_2_Name,
    m.season AS Season,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.runs_scored >= 50 THEN d1.delivery_id END) AS Number_of_50_Stands
FROM 
    Players p1
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON p1.player_id != p2.player_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim2 ON p2.player_id = pim2.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim1.match_id = m.match_id AND pim2.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d1 ON pim1.match_id = d1.match_id AND pim1.player_id = d1.striker_id AND d1.inning = 1
JOIN 
    Deliveries d2 ON pim2.match_id = d2.match_id AND pim2.player_id = d2.non_striker_id AND d2.inning = 1
WHERE 
    d1.bowler_id != d1.striker_id AND d1.bowler_id != d2.striker_id
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_name, p2.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY 
    Number_of_50_Stands DESC;

gold_sql:
WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)
    FROM SeasonDefeats
  )
ORDER BY
  "season";

question: the 5 highest average run rates over a season by a team in powerplay.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  m.season,
  CASE
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE d.batting_team
  END AS franchise,
  SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / COUNT(
    CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END
  ) AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries AS d
JOIN Matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  d.over_number <= 5
GROUP BY
  m.season,
  franchise
ORDER BY
  run_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:

    m.season AS Season,
    d.batting_team AS Franchise,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.over_number <= 6 THEN d.delivery_id END) AS Powerplay Run Rate
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.over_number <= 6
GROUP BY 
    m.season, d.batting_team
ORDER BY 
    Powerplay Run Rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: list bowling stats of Fazalhaq Farooqi in IPL 2025
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

question: 5 Highest totals after being 3 down for < 35 in an IPL innings
gold_sql:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)

  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Of the matches that were played for 20 overs, list the two highest powerplay score by a team losing five or more wickets in Powerplay in IPL.list the teams, runs in pp, the opponent and the year.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."powerplay_runs",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = T2."team1"
    THEN T2."team2"
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END AS "opponent",
  T2."season"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "powerplay_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT("player_out_id") >= 5
) AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."match_id" IN (
    SELECT
      "match_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      MAX("over_number") >= 19
  )
ORDER BY
  T1."powerplay_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: Highest SR in debut IPL innings (10+ balls)
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInnings AS (

  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate

question: ਪਲੇਇੰਗ ਇਲੈਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 10 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ)। ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ, ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."match_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."player_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS rn
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS player_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    SUM("runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."team1" || ' vs ' || T3."team2" AS teams,
  T2.player_score,
  T2.balls_faced,
  T3."season"
FROM DebutMatches AS T1
JOIN BattingStats AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1 AND T2.balls_faced >= 10
ORDER BY
  T2.strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 75 रन या उससे कम के स्कोर पर पहले 5 विकेट गंवाने के बाद, सफलतापूर्वक हासिल किए गए 3 सबसे बड़े लक्ष्यों की सूची दें। टीमों, लक्ष्य (target) और वर्ष का भी उल्लेख करें।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

    m.team1 AS WinningTeam,
    d.runs_scored AS TargetScore,
    m.season AS Season
FROM Matches AS m
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.match_winner = m.team1
    AND d.inning = 1
    AND d.runs_scored <= 75
    AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Deliveries AS d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
        AND d2.inning = 1
        AND d2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
        AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    ) <= 5
ORDER BY 
    d.runs_scored DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: अपने IPL डेब्यू मैच में कम से कम 10 गेंदें खेलने वाले, सबसे ज़्यादा स्ट्राइक रेट वाले 5 खिलाड़ियों की सूची दें। उस मैच में खिलाड़ी का नाम, उनके रन और गेंदें, दोनों टीमें और साल भी बताएं।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,

    m.team1 AS Team 1,
    m.team2 AS Team 2,
    m.season AS Season
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id

HAVING SUM(d.ball_number) >= 10
ORDER BY Strike Rate DESC

question: ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਓਪਨਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਰਫ 0 ਰੰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਗੁਆਉਣ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ। ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਓਪਨਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
