  T3."season",
  T1."batting_team",
  T4."player_name",
  T5."player_name"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id" AS opener1,
    "non_striker_id" AS opener2
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
) AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1.opener1 = T4."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T1.opener2 = T5."player_id"
WHERE
  (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener1
  ) = 0
  AND (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener2
  ) = 0
  AND T1.opener1 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  )
  AND T1.opener2 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  );

question: IPL డెబ్యూ మ్యాచ్లో కనీసం 10 బంతులు ఆడిన అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్న 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు? ఆ మ్యాచ్లో క్రీడాకారి పేరు, పరుగులు మరియు బంతులు, ఇద్దరి టీముల పేరులు మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('Urvil Patel', 31, 11, 281.8181818181818, 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Chennai Super Kings', '2025')", "('V Nigam', 39, 15, 260.0, 'Lucknow Super Giants', 'Delhi Capitals', '2025')", "('R Ravindra', 37, 15, 246.66666666666666, 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 'Chennai Super Kings', '2024')", "('SK Raina', 32, 13, 246.15384615384616, 'Kings XI Punjab', 'Chennai Super Kings', '2007/08')", "('Abhishek Sharma', 46, 19, 242.10526315789474, 'Delhi Daredevils', 'Royal Challengers Bangalore', '2018')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.ball_number) / 6), 2) AS Strike Rate,
    m.team1 AS Team 1,
    m.team2 AS Team 2,
    m.season AS Season
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE d.ball_number >= 10
GROUP BY p.player_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
ORDER BY Strike Rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,

question: IPL లో అతన డెబ్యూ IPL ఇన్నింగ్లో కనీసం 10 బంతుల ఆడిన అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్న 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు? క్రీడాకారి పేరు, ఆ మ్యాచ్లో పరుగులు మరియు బంతులు, మ్యాచ్లో టీములు మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInning AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("match_date") AS debut_date
  FROM "Deliveries"
  JOIN "Matches"
    ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM DebutInning AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  AND T1.debut_date = T3."match_date"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."striker_id",
  T2."match_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,

    m.team2 AS Team 2,
    m.season AS Season
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id

    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.striker_id

    (SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number)) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਆਪਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ IPL ਪਾਰੀ (ਜਦੋਂ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੀਤੀ) ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 10 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ। ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਉਸਦੀਆਂ ਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ, ਮੈਚ ਦੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInning AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("match_date") AS debut_date
  FROM "Deliveries"
  JOIN "Matches"
    ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM DebutInning AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  AND T1.debut_date = T3."match_date"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."striker_id",
  T2."match_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Runs Scored,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    m.team1 AS Team 1,
    m.team2 AS Team 2,
    m.season AS Season
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

    AND d.runs_scored > 0
GROUP BY

ORDER BY 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: give the players who did not hit a boundary in the first 20 balls of their innings in ipl 2025.give the player name and their score in that match
gold_sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  FROM RankedBalls
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    MAX(ball_faced_num) >= 20
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN ball_faced_num <= 20 AND "runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS score_in_match
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN NoBoundaryInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T4."player_name",
  T1."match_id"
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Score in Match
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2025' AND team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' OR team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings')
    AND d.inning = 1
    AND d.over_number <= 2
    AND d.ball_number <= 4
    AND d.runs_scored < 4
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name;

question: उन सभी उदाहरणों को सूचीबद्ध करें जहाँ किसी टीम के दोनों सलामी बल्लेबाज़ शून्य पर आउट हुए हैं। सूची में टीम, सलामी बल्लेबाज़ों और वर्ष का विवरण दें।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."season",
  T1."batting_team",
  T4."player_name",
  T5."player_name"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id" AS opener1,
    "non_striker_id" AS opener2
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
) AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1.opener1 = T4."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T1.opener2 = T5."player_id"
WHERE
  (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener1

gold_sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1

    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (

question: list the 5 highest strike rates of a player with minimum 10 balls played in their debut ipl inning(the first time they batted in ipl).give the player, their runs and balls in that match, teams in that match, and year.
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInning AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("match_date") AS debut_date
  FROM "Deliveries"
  JOIN "Matches"
    ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM DebutInning AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  AND T1.debut_date = T3."match_date"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."striker_id",
  T2."match_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH DebutInnings AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name AS PlayerName,
        d.runs_scored AS RunsScored,
        SUM(d.ball_number) AS BallsFaced,
        m.team1 AS Team1,
        m.team2 AS Team2,
        m.season AS Season
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    WHERE pim.match_id IN (
        SELECT min(pim2.match_id)

        WHERE pim2.player_id = pim.player_id
        GROUP BY pim2.player_id

    HAVING SUM(d.ball_number) >= 10

RankedDebutInnings AS (
    SELECT
        PlayerName,
        RunsScored,
        BallsFaced,
        Team1,
        Team2,
        Season,
        CAST(RunsScored AS REAL) / BallsFaced AS StrikeRate
    FROM DebutInnings
)

    PlayerName,
    RunsScored,
    BallsFaced,
    Team1,
    Team2,
    Season
FROM RankedDebutInnings
ORDER BY StrikeRate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: *IPL में किसी एक गेंदबाज़ के खिलाफ़ उच्चतम स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) वाले 4 बल्लेबाज़ कौन हैं (न्यूनतम 50 गेंदें)? उनके रन और खेली गई गेंदें भी बताएं।**
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", T3."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs", COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", T3."player_name" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 50 ORDER BY "strike_rate" DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Striker_Name,
    p2.player_name AS Bowler_Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.ball_number) / 100), 2) AS Strike_Rate
FROM 
    Players p1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p1.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id

    m.season = 'IPL'

    AND d.noballs = 0

question: list all instances of most balls bowled in an over.give balls, bowler, team in the match and the year
gold_sql:
WITH OverCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "bowling_team",
    COUNT(*) AS balls_in_over
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number"
)
SELECT
  T1.balls_in_over,
  T3."player_name",
  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."season"
FROM OverCounts AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.balls_in_over = (
    SELECT
      MAX(balls_in_over)
    FROM OverCounts
  );

question: give the lowest powerplay scores of ipl 2025.give the teams involved in the match, powerplay score with wickets and the city.(consider the matches that were played complete)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."team1",
  T1."team2",
  T2."batting_team",
  T2.pp_runs || '/' || T2.pp_wickets AS powerplay_score,
  T1."city"
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS pp_runs,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS pp_wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T1."result_type" IN ('runs', 'wickets')
ORDER BY
  pp_runs ASC,
  pp_wickets DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Mumbai Indians', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', '24/4', 'Hyderabad')", "('Mumbai Indians', 'Gujarat Titans', 'Gujarat Titans', '29/1', 'Mumbai')", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 'Chennai Super Kings', 'Chennai Super Kings', '30/3', 'Chennai')", "('Chennai Super Kings', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Chennai Super Kings', '31/2', 'Chennai')", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 'Punjab Kings', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', '33/4', 'Bengaluru')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team1 AS Team_1,
    team2 AS Team_2,
    CASE 
        WHEN batting_team = team1 THEN team1
        ELSE team2
    END AS Batting_Team,
    SUM(runs_scored) AS Powerplay_Score,
    city
FROM Deliveries
JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE 
    Matches.season = '2025' 
    AND Matches.result_type = 'complete'
    AND inning = 1
    AND over_number <= 6
GROUP BY 
    team1, team2, city
ORDER BY 
    Powerplay_Score ASC;

question: एक ओवर में सबसे ज़्यादा गेंदें फेंकने के सभी मौकों की सूची दें। हर मामले में गेंदों की संख्या, गेंदबाज़, मैच में टीम और साल बताएँ।
gold_sql:
WITH OverCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "bowling_team",
    COUNT(*) AS balls_in_over
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number"
)
SELECT
  T1.balls_in_over,
  T3."player_name",
  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."season"
FROM OverCounts AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.balls_in_over = (
    SELECT
      MAX(balls_in_over)
    FROM OverCounts
  );
gold_answer: ["(11, 'Mohammed Siraj', 'Royal Challengers Bangalore', '2023')", "(11, 'TU Deshpande', 'Chennai Super Kings', '2023')", "(11, 'SN Thakur', 'Lucknow Super Giants', '2025')", "(11, 'Sandeep Sharma', 'Rajasthan Royals', '2025')", "(11, 'HH Pandya', 'Mumbai Indians', '2025')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Balls_in_Over,
    p.player_name,
    d.bowling_team,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY 
    d.bowler_id, m.season, d.bowling_team
ORDER BY 
    Balls_in_Over DESC;

question: ఒక ఓవర్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బంతులు విసిరిన అన్నీ ఉదాహరణాలు ఇవ్వండి. ప్రతి ఉదాహరణానికి బంతులు, బౌలర్, మ్యాచ్లో ఉన్న టీం మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH OverCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "bowling_team",
    COUNT(*) AS balls_in_over
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number"
)
SELECT
  T1.balls_in_over,
  T3."player_name",
  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."season"
FROM OverCounts AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.balls_in_over = (
    SELECT
      MAX(balls_in_over)
    FROM OverCounts
  );

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Balls_in_Over,
    p.player_name,
    d.bowling_team,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY 
    d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, m.season

question: ਇੱਕ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੇ ਜਾਣ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ। ਗੇਂਦਾਂ, ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼, ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH OverCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "bowling_team",
    COUNT(*) AS balls_in_over
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number"
)
SELECT
  T1.balls_in_over,
  T3."player_name",
  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."season"
FROM OverCounts AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.balls_in_over = (
    SELECT
      MAX(balls_in_over)
    FROM OverCounts
  );

    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id

    d.bowler_id, m.season, d.bowling_team
ORDER BY 
    Balls_in_Over DESC;

question: IPL 2025 లో అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ పవర్ప్లే స్కోర్ ఏమిటి? మ్యాచ్లో ఉన్న టిములు, విక్కెట్ల తో పాటు పవర్ప్లే స్కోర్ మరియు నగర రాయండి. మొత్తం ఆడిన మ్యాచులనే రాయండి.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."team1",
  T1."team2",
  T2."batting_team",
  T2.pp_runs || '/' || T2.pp_wickets AS powerplay_score,
  T1."city"
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS pp_runs,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS pp_wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T1."result_type" IN ('runs', 'wickets')
ORDER BY
  pp_runs ASC,
  pp_wickets DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Mumbai Indians', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', '24/4', 'Hyderabad')", "('Mumbai Indians', 'Gujarat Titans', 'Gujarat Titans', '29/1', 'Mumbai')", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 'Chennai Super Kings', 'Chennai Super Kings', '30/3', 'Chennai')", "('Chennai Super Kings', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Chennai Super Kings', '31/2', 'Chennai')", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 'Punjab Kings', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', '33/4', 'Bengaluru')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team1 AS "Team 1",
    team2 AS "Team 2",
    batting_team AS "Batting Team",
    MIN(CASE WHEN over_number <= 6 THEN SUM(runs_scored) ELSE 0 END) AS "Powerplay Score",
    city
FROM 
    Matches
JOIN 
    Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
WHERE 
    season = 'IPL 2025'
GROUP BY 
    team1, team2, batting_team, city
ORDER BY 
    "Powerplay Score" ASC;

question: IPL లో బౌలర్లల వ్యతిరేకంగా 4 అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేటులు ఏమిటి (కనీసం 50 బంతులు)? వాళ్ళ పరుగులు మరియు బంతులు రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", T3."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs", COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", T3."player_name" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 50 ORDER BY "strike_rate" DESC LIMIT 4
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS StrikerName,
    p2.player_name AS BowlerName,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.ball_number) / 6), 2) AS StrikeRate
FROM 
    Players p1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim1.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.bowler_id != 'run out'
    AND d.bowler_id != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.bowler_id != 'obstructing the field'
    AND p1.player_name != 'unknown'
    AND p2.player_name != 'unknown'
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_id, p2.player_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.ball_number) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    StrikeRate DESC;

question: LSG కోసం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T2."player_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."team_name" = 'Lucknow Super Giants' GROUP BY T3."player_name" ORDER BY SUM(T1."runs_scored") DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pim.team_name = 'LSG'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Total Runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: पारी के आखिरी ओवर में Stoinis की बैटिंग के आँकड़े बताइए, जिसमें उनके रन, खेली गई गेंदें, आउट, स्ट्राइक रेट, चौके और छक्के शामिल हों।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T2."player_name" = 'MP Stoinis' AND T1."over_number" = 19
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Dismissals,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number) * 100,2) AS Strike Rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Fours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sixes
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.over_number = 20 AND p.player_name = 'Stoinis'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name;

question: అన్నీ ఎడిషన్లలో ఒక ఓపెనర్ యొక్క అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ 50+ స్కోర్లు ఏమిటి? క్రీడాకారి పేరు, అతన స్త్రీక, ఆ స్త్రీకలో చేసిన స్కోర్, టిములు మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి. అన్నిటికన్నా పొడవైన స్త్రీక ఉన్న అన్నీ ఉదాహరణాలు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,

question: *IPL में RR के लिए छठे विकेट या उससे नीचे की 2 सबसे बड़ी साझेदारियों की सूची दें। साझेदारी में बने रन और इसमें शामिल बल्लेबाजों के नाम बताएं।**
gold_sql:
WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"
)
SELECT
  T1."partnership_runs",
  T2."batters"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN PartnershipBatters AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."partnership_group" = T2."partnership_group"
ORDER BY
  T1."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(92, 'R Parag, SO Hetmyer')", "(85, 'SPD Smith, JP Faulkner')"]
generated_sql:

    SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) AS Partnership_Runs,

question: सभी संस्करणों में किसी ओपनर द्वारा बनाए गए सबसे ज़्यादा लगातार 50+ स्कोर। खिलाड़ी का नाम, उनकी स्ट्रीक, उस स्ट्रीक में बनाए गए स्कोर, (विपक्षी) टीमें और साल बताएं। सबसे लंबी स्ट्रीक के सभी उदाहरणों की सूची दें।

WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T1."streak_count",
  T1."scores",
  T1."teams",
  T1."years"
FROM StreakDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN MaxStreak AS T2
  ON T1."streak_count" = T2.max_streak
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."player_name";

WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"

question: most 50+ consecutive scores by an opener across all editions.give the player, his streak, the scores in that streak and the teams and the year.list all the instances of highest streak
gold_sql:
WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T1."streak_count",
  T1."scores",
  T1."teams",
  T1."years"
FROM StreakDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN MaxStreak AS T2
  ON T1."streak_count" = T2.max_streak
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."player_name";

        p.player_name AS Player_Name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Streak_Count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(d.runs_scored) AS Scores,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN m.team1 ELSE m.team2 END) AS Teams,
        m.season AS Years
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.striker_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN (SELECT player_name FROM Players WHERE player_name LIKE 'A%')
    GROUP BY p.player_name

    SELECT MAX(Streak_Count) AS MaxStreak FROM PlayerStreaks
)
SELECT 
    Player_Name,
    Streak_Count,
    Scores,
    Teams,
    Years
FROM PlayerStreaks
WHERE Streak_Count = (SELECT MaxStreak FROM MaxStreaks)
ORDER BY Player_Name;

question: RCB के खिलाफ CSK की सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी (किसी भी विकेट के लिए)
gold_sql:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Player_1_Name,
    p2.player_name AS Player_2_Name,
    SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) AS Partnership_Runs
FROM 
    Deliveries AS d1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id AND p1.team_name = 'RCB'
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS p2 ON d1.non_striker_id = p2.player_id AND p2.team_name = 'CSK'
WHERE 
    d1.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'CSK' AND team2 = 'RCB' OR team1 = 'RCB' AND team2 = 'CSK')
    AND d1.wicket_type IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_name, p2.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Partnership_Runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ Dhoni ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ; ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਰਨ, ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1."runs_scored"), COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END), CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END), CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T2."player_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" WHERE T2."player_name" = 'MS Dhoni' AND T3."city" = 'Bangalore'

SELECT 
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs_Scored,
    SUM(D.ball_number) AS Balls_Faced,
    ROUND((SUM(D.runs_scored) / SUM(D.ball_number)) * 100, 2) AS Strike_Rate,
    ROUND(AVG(D.runs_scored / (D.ball_number + (D.wides + D.noballs))), 2) AS Batting_Average
FROM 
    Players P

    PlayerInMatch PIM ON P.player_id = PIM.player_id

    Matches M ON PIM.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries D ON PIM.match_id = D.match_id AND P.player_id = D.striker_id
WHERE 
    M.city = 'Bangalore' AND P.player_name = 'Dhoni' AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field');

question: Highest partnerships for CSK vs RCB (any wicket)
gold_sql:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Player_1_Name,
    p2.player_name AS Player_2_Name,
    SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) AS Partnership_Runs
FROM 
    Players p1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id AND pim1.team_name = 'Chennai Super Kings'
JOIN 
    Deliveries d1 ON pim1.match_id = d1.match_id AND p1.player_id = d1.striker_id
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON p2.player_id = d1.non_striker_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim2 ON pim2.player_id = p2.player_id AND pim2.team_name = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
JOIN 
    Deliveries d2 ON pim2.match_id = d2.match_id AND p2.player_id = d2.non_striker_id
WHERE 
    d1.match_id = d2.match_id
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_id, p2.player_id
ORDER BY 
    Partnership_Runs DESC;

question: 4 Fastest fifty in IPL history (by balls faced). give the player team and the year
gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT "match_id", "striker_id", "batting_team", SUM("runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs", SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "balls_faced" FROM "Deliveries"), FiftyData AS (SELECT "match_id", "striker_id", "batting_team", MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50" FROM PlayerInnings WHERE "cumulative_runs" >= 50 GROUP BY "match_id", "striker_id") SELECT T3."player_name", T2."batting_team", T4."season", T2."balls_to_reach_50" FROM FiftyData AS T2 INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3 ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id" INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4 ON T2."match_id" = T4."match_id" ORDER BY T2."balls_to_reach_50" ASC LIMIT 4

        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.striker_id = d.striker_id
        AND d2.match_id = d.match_id
        AND d2.inning = d.inning
        AND d2.over_number <= d.over_number
        AND d2.ball_number <= d.ball_number

question: all instances for the Most consecutive 50-plus scores for RCB in the IPL
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date,
    SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: IPL की एक पारी में (पूरे 20 ओवर खेलने के बाद) किसी टीम द्वारा खेली गई सबसे कम डॉट बॉल्स। ऐसे 6 मौकों की सूची दें।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1.batting_team,
  T2.season,
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
GROUP BY
  T1.match_id,
  T1.inning
HAVING
  MAX(T1.over_number) = 19
ORDER BY
  dot_balls ASC
LIMIT 6;
gold_answer: ["('Sunrisers Hyderabad', '2024', 22)", "('Gujarat Titans', '2025', 22)", "('Delhi Capitals', '2020/21', 23)", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', '2024', 23)", "('Sunrisers Hyderabad', '2017', 24)", "('Gujarat Titans', '2024', 24)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    BattingTeam AS Batting_Team,
    M.season AS Season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN D.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Dot_Balls
FROM 
    Matches AS M
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
    M.season LIKE 'IPL%'
    AND D.inning = 1
    AND D.over_number <= 20
    AND D.wides = 0
    AND D.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    BattingTeam, M.season
ORDER BY 
    Dot_Balls ASC
LIMIT 6;

question: एक पारी में किसी गेंदबाज़ द्वारा सर्वाधिक छक्के।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T2."player_name" ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Number of Sixes
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored = 6
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Number of Sixes DESC;

question: ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ బౌలర్ అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఇచ్చాడు? బౌలర్ యొక్క పేరు మరియు సిక్సులు రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T2."player_name" ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS PlayerName,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NumberOfSixes
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.runs_scored = 6
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    NumberOfSixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T2."player_name" ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 1;

    p.player_name AS Player_Name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS Number_Of_Sixes
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored = 6
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Number_Of_Sixes DESC;

question: 4 fasteest to reach 4000 runs in terms of balls played
gold_sql:
WITH CumulativeData AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_balls"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), MilestoneReached AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("cumulative_balls") AS "balls_to_4000"
  FROM CumulativeData
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 4000
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT

question: list all instances of 4 or more batters scoring 40+ runs in an inning.give the teams in the match and the year
gold_sql:
WITH BatterScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 40
), InningsWith40Plus AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM BatterScores
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    COUNT("striker_id") >= 4
)
SELECT
  T2."season",
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team2"
  END
FROM InningsWith40Plus AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id";

question: 5 Most consecutive scores of 25 or more in IPL.give players and streak
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id" AS "player_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), ScoresWithDate AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_date",
    CASE
      WHEN T1."runs" >= 25 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_25plus"
  FROM PlayerMatchRuns AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "is_25plus",
    (
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "is_25plus" ORDER BY "match_date")
    ) AS "streak_group"
  FROM ScoresWithDate
), StreakLengths AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  WHERE
    "is_25plus" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."streak"
FROM StreakLengths AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."streak" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('SA Yadav', 16)", "('RV Uthappa', 10)", "('SPD Smith', 9)", "('V Kohli', 9)", "('B Sai Sudharsan', 9)"]

        striker_id AS Player_Id,
        runs_scored AS Runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY delivery_id) AS Streak
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE series_name = 'IPL')
    AND runs_scored >= 25
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS Player_Name,
    MAX(Streak) AS "25+ Score Streak"
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerScores ps ON p.player_id = ps.Player_Id
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY "25+ Score Streak" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ 25 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ; ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ streak ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id" AS "player_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), ScoresWithDate AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_date",
    CASE
      WHEN T1."runs" >= 25 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_25plus"
  FROM PlayerMatchRuns AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "is_25plus",
    (
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "is_25plus" ORDER BY "match_date")
    ) AS "streak_group"
  FROM ScoresWithDate
), StreakLengths AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  WHERE
    "is_25plus" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."streak"
FROM StreakLengths AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."streak" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('SA Yadav', 16)", "('RV Uthappa', 10)", "('SPD Smith', 9)", "('V Kohli', 9)", "('B Sai Sudharsan', 9)"]

FROM

JOIN

LEFT JOIN

LEFT JOIN 
    Deliveries d4 ON pim.match_id = d4.match_id AND p.player_id = d4.striker_id AND d4.delivery_id = d3.delivery_id + 1

question: 5 bowlers with Most wickets in the powerplay in IPL 2025
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.delivery_id) FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id WHERE T3.season = '2025' AND T1.over_number <= 5 AND T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.delivery_id) DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' AND d.over_number <= 6 THEN 1 END) AS Wickets
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    pim.team_name = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    AND d.season = 'IPL 2025'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Wickets DESC
LIMIT 
    5;

question: 4 bowlers with Most 4-plus wicket hauls in the IPL
gold_sql:
WITH HaulCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS num_hauls
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "bowler_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
      AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
    GROUP BY
      "bowler_id",
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      COUNT(*) >= 4
  )
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), RankedHauls AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    "num_hauls",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "num_hauls" DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM HaulCounts
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."num_hauls"
FROM RankedHauls AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rnk <= 4
ORDER BY
  T1."num_hauls" DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Total Hauls
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
    AND d.runs_scored >= 4
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Total Hauls DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: give all instances of Four wickets in an over for a bowler in IPL.give the bowler, team, city and year
gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", T1."bowling_team", T2."city", T2."season" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."bowler_id" HAVING count(*) = 4
gold_answer: ["('A Mishra', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Pune', '2013')", "('YS Chahal', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Mumbai', '2022')", "('AD Russell', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Navi Mumbai', '2022')", "('YS Chahal', 'Punjab Kings', 'Chennai', '2025')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.bowler_id AS Bowler Name,
    p.player_name AS Bowling Team,
    m.city AS City,
    m.season AS Season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored = 4
    AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw')

question: 3 bowlers with Multiple hat-tricks in IPL
gold_sql:
WITH WicketDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    CASE
      WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
),
SequencedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev_is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev2_is_wicket"
  FROM WicketDeliveries
),
HatTricks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id"
  FROM SequencedWickets
  WHERE "is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev_is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev2_is_wicket" = 1
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name"
FROM HatTricks AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
HAVING
  COUNT(T1."match_id") > 1
ORDER BY
  COUNT(T1."match_id") DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH WicketDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    CASE
      WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
),
SequencedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev_is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev2_is_wicket"
  FROM WicketDeliveries
),
HatTricks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id"
  FROM SequencedWickets
  WHERE "is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev_is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev2_is_wicket" = 1
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name"
FROM HatTricks AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"

HAVING
  COUNT(T1."match_id") > 1
ORDER BY
  COUNT(T1."match_id") DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: IPL లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు 4+ వికెట్లు తీసుకున్న 4 బౌలర్లు ఎవరు?
gold_sql:
WITH HaulCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS num_hauls
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "bowler_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
      AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
    GROUP BY
      "bowler_id",
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      COUNT(*) >= 4
  )
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), RankedHauls AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    "num_hauls",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "num_hauls" DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM HaulCounts
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."num_hauls"
FROM RankedHauls AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rnk <= 4
ORDER BY
  T1."num_hauls" DESC;

question: highest partnership for any wicket for Rajasthan Royals.give the runs and players involved opposition and the year
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS partnership_group_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM PartnershipDetails
  GROUP BY "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "non_striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
  )
),
FullPartnerships AS (
  SELECT
    pr."match_id",
    pr.total_runs,
    GROUP_CONCAT(p."player_name", ', ') AS players
  FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
  JOIN PartnershipPlayers AS pp
    ON pr."match_id" = pp."match_id"
    AND pr."inning" = pp."inning"
    AND pr."partnership_group_id" = pp."partnership_group_id"

    ON pp.player_id = p."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    pr."match_id",
    pr."inning",
    pr."partnership_group_id",
    pr.total_runs
  HAVING COUNT(pp.player_id) >= 2
)

question: which 4 players had Best batting average vs a team in IPL (min 500 runs).give the average, runs, the opponent and the player
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerAverages AS (
  SELECT
    T2."player_name",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs,
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2
    ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
  "player_name",
  "bowling_team" AS "opponent",
  total_runs,
  batting_average
FROM PlayerAverages
WHERE batting_average >= (
  SELECT batting_average
  FROM PlayerAverages
  ORDER BY batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਰੱਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ 4 ਖਿਡਾਰੀ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 500 ਰਨ)। ਔਸਤ, ਰਨ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerAverages AS (
  SELECT
    T2."player_name",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs,
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2
    ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
  "player_name",
  "bowling_team" AS "opponent",
  total_runs,
  batting_average
FROM PlayerAverages
WHERE batting_average >= (
  SELECT batting_average
  FROM PlayerAverages
  ORDER BY batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

question: which bowler has the most wickets in the 1st ball of the innings.mention the bowler and the players he has dismissed in those balls

question: the 5 players with least strike rate to face 100+ balls in ipl 2025.mention the player, runs, balls, strike rate.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T3.season = '2025'
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  strike_rate
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number) * 100, 2) AS Strike Rate
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pim.team_name = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    AND d.season = '2025'
    AND d.ball_number > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.ball_number) >= 100
ORDER BY 
    Strike Rate ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਪਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਗੇਂਦ 'ਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਕੌਣ ਹੈ? ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਸਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਆਊਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS WicketCount
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
    AND "ball_number" = 1
    AND "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), TopBowlers AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id"
  FROM WicketCounts
  WHERE
    WicketCount = (
      SELECT
        MAX(WicketCount)
      FROM WicketCounts
    )
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN TopBowlers AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."bowler_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_out_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."over_number" = 0
  AND T1."ball_number" = 1
  AND T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out');

question: IPL 2025 में सबसे कम स्ट्राइक रेट वाले उन 5 खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताएं, जिन्होंने कम से कम 100 गेंदें खेली हों। खिलाड़ी का नाम, रन, गेंदें और स्ट्राइक रेट भी बताएं।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T3.season = '2025'
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  strike_rate
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls Faced,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number) * 100, 2) AS Strike Rate
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pim.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = 'IPL 2025')
    AND d.ball_number > 0
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.ball_number) >= 100
ORDER BY 
    Strike Rate ASC
LIMIT 
    5;

question: all instances of 140-plus totals after being 4 down for less than 15 in IPL.give score after 4 wickets down and then the final score and the team
gold_sql:
WITH InningProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FourthWicketFall AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_runs" AS score_at_4_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS rn
    FROM InningProgress
    WHERE
      "cumulative_wickets" = 4
  )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), FinalScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS final_score
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."score_at_4_wickets",
  T2."final_score"
FROM FourthWicketFall AS T1
JOIN FinalScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
WHERE
  T1."score_at_4_wickets" < 15 AND T2."final_score" >= 140;
gold_answer: ["('Delhi Daredevils', 7, 146)", "('Mumbai Indians', 7, 145)", "('Chennai Super Kings', 7, 156)", "('Punjab Kings', 14, 183)", "('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 13, 143)"]

SELECT 
    t1.team_name AS Batting_Team,
    (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id AND d2.inning = d.inning AND d2.ball_number <= (SELECT ball_number FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = d.match_id AND inning = d.inning AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ball_number ASC LIMIT 4)) AS Score_at_4_Wickets,
    SUM(runs_scored) AS Final_Score
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN PlayerInMatch p ON d.match_id = p.match_id AND d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.team_type = 'IPL' AND
    d.inning = 1 AND
    d.runs_scored > 140 AND
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = d.match_id AND inning = d.inning AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL) <= 4
GROUP BY t1.team_name, d.match_id
ORDER BY Final_Score DESC;

question: IPL లో ఏ మ్యాచులలో ఒక టీం 15 పరుగుల కన్నా తక్కువలో 4 వికెట్లు పోగొట్టుకున్న తరువాత 140 కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ చేశారు? 4 వికెట్లు పడిన సమయం అప్పుడు స్కోర్, చివరి స్కోర్ మరియు టీం యొక్క పేరు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH InningProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FourthWicketFall AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_runs" AS score_at_4_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS rn
    FROM InningProgress
    WHERE
      "cumulative_wickets" = 4
  )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), FinalScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS final_score
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."score_at_4_wickets",
  T2."final_score"
FROM FourthWicketFall AS T1
JOIN FinalScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
WHERE
  T1."score_at_4_wickets" < 15 AND T2."final_score" >= 140;

question: MI बनाम CSK मैचों में हुई 100+ रनों की सभी साझेदारियों की सूची दें।
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    T1.over_number,
    T1.ball_number,
    MIN(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p1_id,
    MAX(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p2_id,
    T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (
      T2.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T2.team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      T2.team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND T2.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians'
    )
), PartnershipChange AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN p1_id != LAG(p1_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) OR p2_id != LAG(p2_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number)
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_partnership
  FROM PartnershipDetails
), PartnershipGroup AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) AS partnership_id
  FROM PartnershipChange
)
SELECT
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name,
  SUM(T3.total_runs) AS partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipGroup AS T3
INNER JOIN Players AS T4
  ON T3.p1_id = T4.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T5
  ON T3.p2_id = T5.player_id
GROUP BY
  T3.match_id,
  T3.inning,
  T3.partnership_id,
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name
HAVING
  partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  partnership_runs DESC;
